title: RAW UNREVIEWED: position-indexed cover-word table separates grammatical cover text from encoded message
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_SOURCE_UNCOLLATED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_RECOMMENDED. Retain a Trithemius Polygraphia I inspired channel in which a message letter selects a cover word from the current column of a shared table. The documented1518 source is later than the proposed Voynich setting; neither its native instructions nor table are collated here. No Voynich correspondence or word assignment.

design.hypothesis: A fixed sequence of cover-word columns supplies grammatical surface positions. At each position the encoded character chooses one entry from that column. One common table and schedule must encode an entire passage, not one free dictionary per paragraph. Productive surface families could belong to cover grammar rather than message vocabulary. This is an unassessed channel hypothesis, not a demonstrated source reconstruction.

source.catalogue_verified: Polygraphiae libri sex, Johannes Trithemius,1518, Latin,256 unnumbered leaves; bound with Clavis polygraphiae.
source.collation_status: Native tables and complete author instructions NOT collated. Online descriptions/search transcriptions were navigation only and are not reliable gold tables. HAB frame URLs identified but no source image acquired or interpreted in this pass. Wellcome viewer required JavaScript verification; no workaround attempted.
source.dating_limit: The1518 printed source cannot be treated as evidence for a c1420 author or a direct Voynich exemplar. Earlier occurrence of the same exact mechanism has not been established.
source.source_needed_before_selection: A complete native key segment plus its explicit advancement/reset instructions and worked message; retain duplicated table entries and all ambiguities rather than assuming column-disjoint vocabularies.

design.finite_consequence: Once the actual shared table and schedule are fixed, every repeated cover word must be licensed in each column where it occurs. A common symbol recoding must satisfy all those occurrences together. If exact repeated forms occupy incompatible column positions, that specific channel is contradicted. Neither arbitrary column restarts nor token-specific homophones may be added after observation. No schedule, target packet, code length or start point is fixed yet.
design.difference_from_old_channels: Unlike one-symbol-for-letter substitution, unknown whole-word translation or1166 abbreviation expansion, a cover word encodes a message character conditional on a fixed external schedule. The cover wording and payload meanings are separate. This difference does not itself establish novelty or viability; no prior failed model is repaired.
design.predecessor_screen: Bounded ideas searches for Trithemius, Polygraphia, Ave Maria, steganography and targeted primary-report searches found no named equivalent. Empty lexical searches are not exhaustive novelty proof. Mixed nomenclator/codebook routes and1164/1166 retain their results.
likely_failures: Wrong historical date and no demonstrated earlier practice.
The source schedule may be incompatible with abundant repeated whole forms.
Unknown symbol recoding plus unknown schedule/table could restore unconstrained codebook freedom.
Even an attractive cover-text reconstruction need not identify the payload language or message.
A structural fit alone is not a translated word.
design.next_step: No research route recommended. Keep in RAW surplus. Only an explicit later selection would justify native source collation and a bounded contract; no decoder, target fit or new corpus now.
design.access: No target payload, image, reserve, gloss assignment, global route/ledger edit, commit or push.
